TextView.android:text: Lesson 2 - Unit 4: Making Verbs with -UM-, MAG-, and MA-
In Tagalog, verbs show past, present, and future tense by changing the form of the root word.
A word that you can turn into a verb.
A word before adding a prefix, infix, or suffix.
To turn a root word into a verb, insert -um-
Placed between first consonant and vowel.
Placed at the beginning of the word
I want to climb the rock.
I want to go outside the house.
What do you want/like to do?
They want to sing in the choir.
She wants to eat in the restaurant.
- is a marker placed before a root word.
It is used to turn a root word into an incompleted or contemplated action in the future.
- is a marker placed before a root word.
It is used show accidental or unintentional actions, or to describe a condition or ability.
